abilities.name: ROLE: Combat specialist
abilities.heading: Destroyers seek conflict.
abilities.description:
Advanced weapons systems, a personal defense barricade, and increased movement abilities allow. Destroyers to take the fight to any threat or rival they encounter during a run. 
[excerpt, UESC threat eval: rnnr.dstryr.fileID55430c_p496]

abilities.name: SEARCH AND DESTROY
abilities.description:
Activate your shoulder-mounted missile pods.

Dealing sustained damage to targets launches homing missiles, Immobilizing and dealing damage upon impact.

abilities.name: RIOT BARRICADE
abilities.description:
Toggle an energy barricade that blocks incoming damage, draining tactical ability energy over time.

Taking damage drains additional energy.

abilities.name: THRUSTER
abilities.description: Activate while airborne to fire boosters that thrust you in the direction you are moving.

abilities.name: TACTICAL SPRINT
abilities.description: Double-press sprint to move faster at the cost of generating additional heat.

file.alt: the only rule is to survive

abilities.name: ROLE: Combat anarchist
abilities.heading: Vandals are troublemakers.
abilities.description:
Amplified movement abilities help cover ground at incredible speeds, changing any encounter in their favor. Microjets allow a secondary jump to reach higher ground. And a built-in Disrupt Cannon provides instant offense or defense when it is charged and ready to fire. 
[excerpt, UESC threat eval: rnnr.vndl.fileID63112c_p324]

abilities.name: AMPLIFY
abilities.description: Overcharge your movement systems, reducing the heat generated from your movement abilities while increasing your movement speed and weapon dexterity.

abilities.name: DISRUPT CANNON
abilities.description:
Transform your arm into a cannon and fire a high-powered energy projectile that deals damage and pushes targets away.

Overcharge your arm cannon greatly increasing. the size and damage of the blast.

abilities.name: MICROJETS
abilities.description: Activate while airborne to perform another jump at the cost of generating additional heat.

abilities.name: POWER SLIDE
abilities.description: Grants a supercharged slide that generates additional heat.

abilities.name: ROLE: Intel specialist
abilities.heading: Recons use intel as a weapon.
abilities.description:
Everything about Recon shells  is geared toward identifying threats and providing insight  into enemy locations and movements: Mark hostiles. Track wounded targets. Deploy a tracker drone to engage threats in unexpected ways. 
[excerpt, UESC threat eval: rnnr.rcn.fileID38406c_p471]

abilities.name: ECHO PULSE
abilities.description: Activate your shell's advanced detection systems, releasing a series of sonar pulses that reveal the location of nearby hostiles.

abilities.name: TRACKER DRONE
abilities.description: Deploy a mechanized microbot that tracks down nearby hostiles and explodes, Overheating any targets caught in the blast.

abilities.name: INTERROGATION
abilities.description:
When pinged by a hostile Runner, you automatically receive a warning your shell's HUD.

Performing a finish on a runner pings their crew.

abilities.name: STALKER PROTOCOL
abilities.description: After breaking a target's shields, they leave behind a lingering holographic trail for a short time.

abilities.name: ROLE: Shadow agent
abilities.heading: Assassins are lethal shadows.
abilities.description:
Active Camo and synthetic smoke deployment allows for unseen strikes or the perfect cover during hostile engagements.  The ability to move undetected makes Assassins valued allies and lethal enemies. 
[excerpt, UESC threat eval: rnnr.assn.fileID70064c_p223]

abilities.name: SMOKE SCREEN
abilities.description: Throw a smoke disc that emits a line of smoke fields in front of you, disrupting the optics of those who step inside.

abilities.name: ACTIVE CAMO
abilities.description:
Activate your shell's camouflage systems, pulling a shroud of invisibility over yourself.

Performing offensive actions, taking damage, and using abilities or consumables briefly disrupts your invisibility.

abilities.name: SHADOW DIVE
abilities.description: Activate while airborne to slam a smoke disc into the ground, deploy a smoke field.

abilities.name: SHROUD
abilities.description:
Your shell automatically activates its camouflage systems when entering any smoke field, making you invisible.

Invisibility persists for a short time after leaving the smoke field.

abilities.name: ROLE: Field medic
abilities.heading: Triage saves lives.
abilities.description:
Deployable healing drones and onboard reboot abilities allow Triage Runners and their crews  to keep running after taking damage. Mend health and shields and even reboot crewmates at a distance to survive and fight again and again. 
[excerpt, UESC threat eval: rnnr.trge.fileID70064c_p392]

abilities.name: REBOOT+
abilities.description:
Ready your shell's emergency defibrillator systems.

Lock on to downed crew members or hostile targets and fire your Reboot+ device at them, which revives crew members and EMPs hostiles.

abilities.name: MED-DRONE
abilities.description: Deploy a floating medical drone that attaches to crew members and restores health or recharges shields, and prevents them from bleeding out while downed.

abilities.name: SHAREWARE.EXE
abilities.description: Benefits from medical consumables are shared between crew members with Med-Drone attached to them.

abilities.name: BATTERY OVERCHARGE
abilities.description:
Divert energy from your cooling systems to boost the performance of your weapons at the cost of generating additional heat.

While active, breaking a target's shield with a volt weapon EMPs them.

abilities.name: ROLE: Covert acquisitions
abilities.heading: A Thief always keeps their eyes  on the prize
abilities.description:
Use enhanced visors and piloted drones to remotely locate and acquire valuable loot. Steal from a zone or rival Runners. Then make an escape or push the advantage with the Thief's deployable grapple device. 
[excerpt, UESC threat eval: rnnr.thf.fileID70064c_p223]

abilities.name: PICKPOCKET DRONE
abilities.description:
Deploy a remotely piloted flying drone with a limited lifespan.

While piloting the drone: 

Fire a hooked tether that can eject the highest-value item from target inventories, collect and store loose loot and open doors.

Exit the drone and return to your shell.

At any point while the drone is still active, activate the ability again to continue piloting the drone.

abilities.name: GRAPPLE DEVICE
abilities.description: Launch a grapple device in your aim direction, propelling yourself toward it.

abilities.name: X-RAY VISOR
abilities.description:
Activate your visor, highlighting hostiles and containers in the color of the most valuable item they're storing. Containers are revealed through walls, while hostiles require line of sight. 

While active, aiming at a hostile for a short time Hacks their optics, disrupting their vision until you look away.

abilities.name: THE FINER THINGS
abilities.description: Gain increased weapon handling and accelerated Grapple Device recharge rate based on the number of items in your Backpack.
